PLUGIN.NAME: Obsidian Connector
PLUGIN.DESCRIPTION: Link Super Productivity projects to Markdown files in an Obsidian vault.

UI.LEDE: Link a Super Productivity project to a note in your Obsidian vault. Opening uses obsidian://, not a file path.
UI.VAULT_NAME_HINT: The vault name shown in Obsidian. Leave empty to use the last vault.
UI.DEFAULT_FOLDER_HINT: Folder used when suggesting a path, e.g. Projects/My project.md.
UI.FILE_PATH_HINT: Path inside the vault, e.g. Projects/Website.md
UI.EMPTY: No projects linked yet. Pick a project and a vault file path, then click Link.
UI.CURRENT_UNLINKED: This project is not linked yet.

MSG.NO_PROJECT_CONTEXT: Open a project first, then try again.
MSG.PROJECT_NOT_LINKED: This project is not linked to an Obsidian file yet.
MSG.URI_COPIED: Could not open Obsidian automatically. The URI was copied to the clipboard.
MSG.INVALID_PATH: Enter a vault-relative path such as Projects/My note.md (no absolute paths or ..).
MSG.CONFIRM_UNLINK: Remove the Obsidian link for "{{title}}"? The note in the vault is not deleted.
